2.209.19
Map.MaximumSpatialElementCount
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The Map.MaximumSpatialElementCount element specifies the maximum number of spatial
elements that are allowed in a Map. This element is optional. If this element is present, its value
MUST be an Integer ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.3.17) or an expression that evaluates to an Integer.
If this element is not present, its value is interpreted as 20000.
The following is the parent element of the Map.MaximumSpatialElementCount element.
Parent elements
Map
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Map.MaximumSpatialElementCount element.
 <xsd:element name="MaximumSpatialElementCount" type="xsd:unsignedInt" minOccurs="0" />
